faq_heading: Questions people ask about AI chatbot cost in the UAE

faqs.q: How much does an AI chatbot cost in the UAE?
faqs.a: Published 2026 guides from UAE vendors put a basic rule-based bot at about AED 6,000 to 45,000 and an AI assistant that answers from your own content at about AED 25,000 to 150,000 to build. Integrated assistants with CRM and WhatsApp cost more. Running costs come on top, so ask each vendor for a one-year total.
Usually not. The guides we checked state their ranges before 5% VAT. Ask every vendor whether the quote is inclusive or exclusive, and compare quotes on the same basis.

faqs.q: How much does WhatsApp cost on top of the chatbot?
faqs.a: Meta charges per delivered message, by category. For UAE numbers from 1 October 2026 its list rate is AED 0.2115 for a marketing message and AED 0.0576 for a utility message. Each business number also gets 1,000 free service replies a month. Your platform provider may add its own fee.

faqs.q: Can an AI chatbot work in Arabic and English?
faqs.a: Yes, but each language has to be tested on real customer messages, not only translated. Gulf Arabic and mixed Arabic-English messages are common, so ask a vendor to show examples before you sign.

faqs.q: How long does it take to launch a chatbot in the UAE?
faqs.a: Published guides give 2 to 10 weeks for a bot that answers from your documents, and several months for deep CRM integration. Clara AI aims to show a first demo within 7 days of receiving your material, so you can judge the answers before a larger scope.
